The association specifically raised concerns over the growing presence of […]
T

Association of Professional Bodies of Nigeria (APBN), sashen Delta State, ya kira gwamnatin Delta State da kuma majalisar kasuwa Uvwie da Udu don su warware sosai matsalolin muhalli, tsaron jama'a da tsaron salbar manyan aikin ababen samarwa da kasuwa a jihar Delta.

articles.hausa_translation: Jiya, Senata Orji Uzor Kalu na wakilin Abia North ya zage PDP da cewa suka juya masa bayan ya ba su kuɗi mai yawa. articles.title: NGX: Renewed buying interest lifts market cap by N2.32trn

articles.hausa_translation: Kasuwar hannun jari na Nigeria: Jikin kasuwa ya tashi da N2.32 triliyan saboda sake bugun shayi a kan manyan jeri. Jiya, kasuwar hannun jari na Nigeria ya murmurewa daga asarar da aka samu a jiya yayin da sake bugun shayi a kan manyan jeri da wasu jeri da aka zaɓa ya ƙara jiya. NGX All-Share Index (ASI) ya tashi da kashi 1.44% zuwa 252,456.74 batu, daga 248,877.22 batu jiya. Wannan haɓaka ya ƙara kusan N2.32 triliyan ga jikin kasuwa.

articles.title: Debt service projected to gulp 71.7% of revenue by 2030
articles.summary: Nigeria’s debt service-to-revenue ratio is projected to rise to 71.7 per cent by 2030, exceeding the 50 per cent threshold recommended by the Debt Management Office (DMO). The projection is contained in the DMO’s 2024 Debt Sustainability Analysis report released on Monday, which warned that debt servicing would consume an increasing proportion of government revenue […]
articles.hausa_translation: Jiyya-jiyya a kasua: An yi tsinkaye cewa kasua da ake bugi-bugi akan kudin gulma zai kai kashi 71.7% na kudin shiga jiya a shekara ta 2030, wanda ya wuce iyakar kashi 50% da Ofishin Gudanarwa ta Gulma (DMO) ta ba da shawarar. Shawarwarin nan ya kasance a cikin rahoton binciken tsarin gulma na 2030 wanda DMO ta fitar da shi jiya, wanda ya gargadi cewa shan gulma zai ci gida gida karama-karama na kudin shiga gwamnati.
critical_questions: Who benefits from high debt servicing and refinancing cycles, and are there vested interests in maintaining elevated debt levels?
